MIDWEST CLASS CHAMPIONSHIPS

October 9-11 or 10-11, 2026
Westin Chicago North Shore Hotel, Wheeling, Illinois

$20,000 PRIZE FUND UNCONDITIONALLY GUARANTEED!



A US Chess Heritage Event!

US CHESS GRAND PRIX POINTS: 120 (ENHANCED)  

 

34th annual Midwest Class Championships.  5 rounds, Swiss-System, 40/80, SD/30; d30 (2-day option, rounds 1-2 G/60, d10). Westin Chicago North Shore Hotel, 601 North Milwaukee Avenue, Wheeling IL 60090 (from Chicago, I-294 north to US-45 north; from Milwaukee, I-94 to Lake Cook Rd to US-45 south). Free parking. 

In 7 sections (see peakrating.us).

·       Premier (2000/up): $2000-1000-500-300, clear win or 1st on tiebreak $100, top USCF U2300 $800-400. FIDE rated.

·       1800-2099: $1400-700-400-200. FIDE rated.

·       1600-1899/Unr: $1400-700-400-200.

·       1400-1699/Unr: $1300-700-400-200.

·       1200-1499/Unr: $1200-600-400-200.

·       Under 1300/Unr: $1000-500-300-200.

·       Under 1100/Unr: $500-300-200-100. 

 

Prize limits: Unrated may not win over $100 in U1100, $200 U1300, $300 1200-1499, $400 1400-1699, or $500 1600-1899.

 

Playing up: See www.peakrating.us .

Playing up: These expanded and overlapping rating class boundaries allow players rated within the top third of each of the sections above the option to play up in the next highest section (also see peakrating.us); Under 1100 players may play in the Under 1100 Section or may elect to play up in Under 1300.


Cannot play below Online Regular rating minus 100 points

.

Mixed Doubles Bonus Prizes: Best male/female 2-player team combined score among all sections: $800-400-200. Team rating must average under 2200; may play in different sections and schedules; register (no extra fee) by 2 pm Sat. 

Top 6 sections entry fee: $118 online at chessaction.com by 10/6; $140 at site, or online until 1 hour before round 1.  

Under 1100 Section entry fee: $40 less than top 6 sections entry fee.  

All: No mailed entries.  No checks, credit cards OK.  Online EF $5 less to ICA members; join/renew at il-chess.org. October official USCF ratings used. Unofficial or Online Regular uschess.org ratings usually used if otherwise unrated. GMs $100 from prize.

Special 1-year USCF dues with magazine if paid online with entry: $54, Senior (age 65+) $48, Young Adult $33, Youth 24.  USCF membership required.

Re-entry $50; no Premier to Premier.
 
3-day schedule: Reg. ends Fri 6 pm. Rounds: Fri 7 pm, Sat 11 am & 5 pm, Sun 10 am & 3:30 pm. 
2-day schedule: Reg. ends Sat 10 am. Rounds: Sat 11 am, 2 pm & 5 pm, Sun 10 am & 3:30 pm. 
Half point byes: OK all rounds, limit 2, must commit before round 2. 

Hotel rates (use this link): $135-135-135-135 (also posted at chessevents.us) or call 847-777-6500, 800-937-8461 and mention Chess rate; reserve by 9/18 or rate may increase.
